reason: The premises about lattice distortions and force-constant fluctuations are supported by E5 and E4/E3, respectively, but the key premise that explicit modeling will yield a 30% improvement over conventional methods is not directly supported by any cited evidence, and E3 suggests force-constant fluctuations in HEAs are similar to binary alloys, potentially undermining the claimed advantage.
premises: Lattice distortions in HEAs reduce phonon velocity and enhance scattering, lowering thermal conductivity
Force-constant fluctuations in HEAs are significant (20-50%) and contribute to phonon attenuation
Explicitly modeling lattice distortions and force-constant fluctuations improves prediction accuracy over conventional methods
Current empirical or ab initio methods do not fully capture disorder-induced scattering effects in HEAs
The approach will reduce prediction error by at least 30% relative to conventional methods for similar HEAs
